newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela sets 20 bln bolivar TEM bill auction.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela sets 20 bln bolivar TEM bill auction.

text.p: The Central Bank of Venezuela announced for Wednesday morning a 20-billion-bolivar auction of 180-, 269- and 358-day "monetary stabilization," or TEM, bills at nominal interest rates of up to 36.99 percent.

The bank said it would offer 10 billion bolivars worth of 180-day bills at a nominal interest rate of 34.12 percent, five billion bolivars of 269-day bills at 35.52 percent and five billion bolivars of 358-day bills at 36.99 percent.
At its auction last week the central bank sold 32.9 billion bolivars worth of 180-, 269- and 358-day bills with yields of 34.12 percent, 25.52 percent and 36.99 percent respectively.
